lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Ah, a fresh face. Sit a moment. Those dungeons have swallowed braver souls than you, so listen well.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Your feet answer to W, A, S and D. When something lunges at you, tap SPACE to dash clear.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: J for a quick strike. K for a heavy one: slower, but it hits hard.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: You carry three weapons. 1 for the sword, 2 for the knife, 3 for the bow. Swap often.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: E is for talking, picking up loot and stepping through doorways. You'll use it more than you think.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: I opens your bag. TAB flicks through your potions, and Q uses the one you've picked.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: The merchant over there trades potions and weapon upgrades for gold. Don't spend it all at once.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Hecate offers gifts, but she only lets you hold one at a time. Once you've chosen, press L to use it.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: And these bookshelves aren't for reading. Four lead into the dungeons. The last one leads to the end of it all.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Then come back and ask again. I'm not going anywhere.
